mapper.sql: select sr.*,b.branch_name,a.name requester_name from stock_request sr join branch b on b.branch_id=sr.branch_id join admin a on a.admin_id=sr.requester_admin_id

where.if: and (lower(sr.request_number) like #{keyword} or lower(b.branch_name) like #{keyword} or exists(select 1 from stock_request_item i join flavor f on f.flavor_id=i.flavor_id where i.stock_request_id=sr.stock_request_id and lower(f.flavor_name) like #{keyword}))
